headline: Storage and distribution loops
lead: Our tanks and loops keep Purified Water (PW) and Water for Injection (WFI) at the quality it left generation, out to the furthest point of use, with turbulent flow and no stagnant branches.

items.q: How do you keep flow turbulent when every point of use is open?
items.a: We size the pump and pipe for peak draw with the minimum return velocity still met, and use variable speed pumps that hold return flow or pressure as demand changes.
Rouge forms in hot WFI and pure steam systems over time. We specify finishes and passivation that slow it and include inspection points so you can trend it and plan derouging.

items.q: Can you add points of use to an existing loop?
items.a: Yes, with a hydraulic check of the whole loop first. Each new branch is welded in with a zero-static valve and requalified.
